name: accessories
description: Bags, watches, jewellery, belts, hats and sunglasses, new or used.

ships.description: True when the seller ships the item. False or absent: handed over in person.

howDealsGo: In person, the buyer looks it over, pays and releases in one tap. Shipped, the buyer pays into escrow first and releases when it arrives as described; the seller records the delivery in their folder, and a timer to the seller, set past the expected arrival, pays if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying for a branded piece, ask for proof it's genuine, such as the receipt.
